known_issues: Page goes blank after deployment (reported in Version 17)

existing_features.title: Diagnose and fix the blank page issue that occurs after deployment. Audit App.tsx for runtime errors including undefined variable access, failed imports, missing null guards on authentication state, and role-based routing logic that may throw before rendering. Ensure the app renders a visible UI for all authentication states (unauthenticated, loading, authenticated with any role).

Add a top-level error boundary component wrapping the entire React application in App.tsx to catch and display any unhandled render errors with a user-friendly fallback UI instead of a blank page. The fallback should show the app name and a message indicating an error occurred with a reload button.

Audit all lazy-loaded or dynamically imported components (maps, Leaflet, QR scanner, camera) for missing Suspense boundaries or import failures that could cause a blank render. Wrap all such components with React.Suspense and appropriate loading fallbacks.

projectName: Fix blank page crash after deployment
